title: Publish release 2.64.0 through the sanctioned script
action: Run `scripts/release.sh 2.64.0` with BEE_DISPATCH_ID set to an authorized deployment dispatch. The script bumps both plugin manifests, runs the regen chain (render-skill-trees, onboard --apply, release-manifest --write), runs the declared test suite before tagging, makes the release commit, tags v2.64.0, pushes main and the tag, waits for the release-binaries workflow and verifies the published assets. Never walk those steps by hand. Re-running at a version already committed is idempotent — it resumes the tail. The regen obligation on .claude-plugin/plugin.json is discharged INSIDE the script's own regen chain, which is why the release manifest rides this cell's files.

truths: tag v2.64.0 exists locally and on the remote
the GitHub release for v2.64.0 carries the binaries and SHA256SUMS
the script printed its final OK line
key_links: the pushed tag is what triggers release-binaries.yml
prohibitions: Do not hand-walk bump, tag or push
Do not skip the test gate

deviations: BEE_OPENCODE_SUITE_ALLOW_SKIP=1 added to the deploy dispatch env, as in releases 2.60.0 to 2.63.0, because the local opencode is a wrapper script
herding ceiling raised from the door 1800 s to 5400 s because the full declared suite exceeded 1800 s earlier the same day
trace.verification_evidence: release cell, evidence https://github.com/thanhsmind/beehive/actions/runs/40528796003 and /mnt/data/Projects/goglbe/beehive/.bee/mailbox/job-1793113776906-873705-1/report-1.md; the script ran the full declared suite before tagging (40 binaries, 4987 passed, 0 failed) and the leader re-checked gh release v2.64.0 (6 assets, not draft) and the run conclusion success

mistakes.wrong: the first deployment dispatch was minted before the lane bookkeeping was committed, so its main_commit pin went stale and a second permit had to be minted
